name: SIMEPROP
recent: Sime Darby Property 在 2026 年 11 月 3 日的特别股东大会上通过了以 RM418.5 million 向 SD Guthrie Berhad 收购柔佛 Kulai 约 556.96 英亩永久地契土地的议案。同期，雇员公积金局 (EPF) 与退休基金局 (KWAP) 多次申报股权变动。新闻方面，公司考虑在 2028 年前设立 REIT，并出售 Nilai 工业地块予 Pekat。
notable: 特别股东大会通过以 RM418.5 million 收购柔佛 Kulai 约 556.96 英亩永久地契土地。
公司考虑在 2028 年前进行 REIT 上市。
Pekat 以 RM31 million 向公司购买位于 Nilai 的六块工业土地。
risks: KWAP 在 2026 年 10 月多次申报股权变动。
EPF 在 2026 年 9 月 21 日申报股权变动。
公司有一项清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人的公告。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 1,160.6 million，环比增长 45.2%，同比增长 9.3%；净利为 MYR 322.0 million，环比增长 102.8%，同比增长 124.4%；净利率为 27.7%，高于上一季度的 19.9%。

recent_en: Sime Darby Property passed the resolution to acquire approximately 556.96 acres of freehold land in Kulai, Johor from SD Guthrie Berhad for RM418.5 million at its EGM on 3 November 2026. Meanwhile, EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests. In the news, the company is considering a REIT listing by 2028 and sold industrial land plots in Nilai to Pekat.
notable_en: EGM approved the acquisition of approximately 556.96 acres of freehold land in Kulai, Johor for RM418.5 million.
The company is considering a REIT listing by 2028.
Pekat acquired six industrial land plots in Nilai from the company for RM31 million.
risks_en: KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests in October 2026.
EPF filed a change in substantial shareholder interest on 21 September 2026.
The company has an announcement on winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,160.6 million, up 45.2% QoQ and 9.3% YoY; net income was MYR 322.0 million, up 102.8% QoQ and 124.4% YoY; net margin was 27.7%, higher than 19.9% in the previous quarter.
